newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo dips vs mark following French franc.
newsitem.headline: Escudo dips vs mark following French franc.

text.p: The escudo slipped against the mark in early trade, following the trend of the French franc and the Italian lira which were both softer against the German currency.
Traders said that the focus was on whether there would be a rate rise in Britain.

The Portuguese currency was trading at 100.97/101.00 to the mark, against its 100.91/94 close on Wednesday. Traders said that the currency enjoyed reasonable support around 101.00 but its trend would depend on currency movements abroad.
